进入美味烹调区域.doc: EN override: same as base, but check 已选择常规菜品 (Standard Dishes tab already open) BEFORE the tab click, because the EN 选择常规菜品 below matches on any cooking tab and would otherwise loop.

选择常规菜品.doc: EN override: the zh unselected-tab icon (常规菜品.png) doesn't match the EN client (~0.56). The cooking screen reopens on whichever tab was used last (Experimental Cooking / Culinary Creations / Standard Dishes), so detect any of them by text and tap the Standard Dishes tab (3rd icon on the left). 已选择常规菜品 (selected-tab icon) matches the EN client as-is. Coords in 1280x720 reference.

跳过动画-美味烹调.doc: EN override: skip the cooking cutscene. zh OCR can't read the white 'Skip' button, so template-match it (image cropped from the EN client) and click. roi = top-right corner.
